cases.name: Sharon Kathleen Hicks Kell
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She was a lifelong resident of the North Georgia Area and of the Christian Faith. Sharon was a graduate of East Ridge High School, class of 1986, was an avid Georgia Bulldawgs Fan, had been employed at Interstate Machinery for the past 3 yrs. and was a loving mother, daughter, grandmother, sister and aunt, who will be greatly missed."
cases.narrative: As deputies arrived at the home, White was seen standing over Kell, firing multiple gunshots.
